meta.description: Receives Sendblue receive-webhook events. Validates the signing secret, acknowledges fast, normalizes + dedupes, runs deterministic opt-out/wrong-number detection BEFORE any model call, checks the global kill switch and per-record state, acquires a contact lock, then hands to SB-03/SB-04.

options.$comment: message_handle column must be UNIQUE so a duplicate webhook retry fails this insert and routes to the duplicate branch.

parameters.jsCode:
console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: 'warn', workflow: 'SB-01', correlation_id: $json.correlation_id, action: 'suppressed_global_kill_switch', message_handle: $json.message.message_handle, ts: new Date().toISOString() }));
return [{ json: { suppressed: true, reason: 'global_ai_disabled' } }];

options.$comment: normalized_phone_hash UNIQUE => concurrent message for same contact fails insert and is debounced into the running conversation (SB-04 re-reads recent messages).
